canada.title: 'I'm fed up': Joly says Stellantis owes Ottawa more than $220M over Brampton plant sale
canada.summary: News that Stellantis has agreed to sell its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel has some workers feeling betrayed and questioning their family’s future.

canada.title: Evacuation alerts lifted in Pemberton Valley as floodwaters recede
canada.summary: Evacuation alerts have been lifted for much of the Pemberton Valley after days of flooding as the flood risk decreases.

canada.title: Nationwide flight grounding unlikely in Canada, says aviation expert
canada.summary: An aviation management expert says Canada is less likely than the United States to ground flights nationwide as that country did on Friday afternoon, calling the Canadian system a model its southern neighbours should look to.

canada.title: Teen charged with 2nd-degree murder in Central Park homicide, Ottawa police say
canada.summary: A 17-year-old has been charged with second-degree murder and attempted murder in connection with a homicide Saturday afternoon in Ottawa's Central Park neighbourhood, police say.

canada.title: Vigil held in Edmonton for family affected by fatal crash in eastern Alberta
canada.summary: Dozens of people held candles while lining the sidewalk across from Stollery Children's Hospital in Edmonton Saturday evening, mourning for a family affected by a fatal collision in eastern Alberta earlier this week.

canada.title: The end of an era: Bombers fans relish final Grey Cup before new rules take effect
canada.summary: Canada's greatest football tradition continues tonight, but the 113th Grey Cup also marks the end of an era. This is the final Grey Cup before CFL commissioner Stewart Johnston's controversial rule changes take effect.

canada.title: 'It's terrifying': Rally calls for changes to Winnipeg roads after 16 died in crashes so far in 2026
canada.summary: Some people who gathered to remember those who've died while travelling on Winnipeg roads say they're concerned that either themselves or their loved ones could be next.

canada.title: One last afternoon in the park for Bailey
canada.summary: Bailey the dog was diagnosed with cancer this year, and her owners are doing everything they can to make sure she has the best time before she is gone. That included throwing her a little party at a Dartmouth park on Sunday so people could show up and give her all the attention in the world.

canada.title: Russia won’t be able to compete in World Juniors, IIHF says
canada.summary: Russia's hockey federation is calling the decision by the IIHF is "unlawful" and plans to appeal the decision to the International Olympic Committee.

canada.title: 'Just devastated': N.B. family wants Route 7 twinned after brother’s death
canada.summary: Kelli Reid's brother was killed in a head-on crash on Route 7 in April. She wants the province to twin the highway.

canada.title: 'Huge loss': Early morning fire destroys Appleton's only convenience store
canada.summary: An early Sunday morning has taken the town of Appleton’s only convenience store — but the town’s mayor is hopeful the community won’t struggle for long.

canada.title: Shooting in Granby, Que., leaves 1 dead, another injured
canada.summary: A man in his 30s was killed, and a woman was injured after two gunmen entered a Granby home and opened fire on Saturday evening.

canada.title: 'He lived and breathed it': NCAA football prospect from N.S. has died
canada.summary: A Nova Scotian who was set to play football at an American powerhouse college is being remembered for his exceptional talent and desire to get better on the field, but also his happy-go-lucky and teddy-bear nature off of it.

canada.title: A hobby that pops: Saskatoon man's massive Coca-Cola collection inspired by rural roots
canada.summary: Jon Aschenbrener of Saskatoon estimates he has 5,000 to 10,000 items in his collection of Coca-Cola memorabilia, which began on the family farm northeast of Cupar, Sask.

canada.title: Carney, Quebec premier discuss U.S. trade, homelessness at first meeting in Cambodia
canada.summary: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said the meeting ended with federal support for the province's fight against homelessness, and the exchange of personal phone numbers. The premier also thanked the prime minister for his support of an economic summit that will take place in Quebec in 2027.

canada.title: N.B. curlers take silver at national mixed championship in P.E.I.
canada.summary: A New Brunswick curling team says it’s thrilled to bring home a silver medal from the Canadian mixed curling championship in Woodstock, P.E.I.

canada.title: One person still missing after fishing boat capsized near Yale, B.C., search and rescue says
canada.summary: One person is still unaccounted for after a fishing boat reportedly capsized on the Fraser River in Yale, B.C., Friday afternoon. In a post to Facebook, Hope Volunteer Search and Rescue said the operation quickly turned into a search, after personnel were told there was another person in the water.

canada.title: Holiday spirit alive in Saskatchewan despite warm weather, lack of snow
canada.summary: It's one of the warmest Novembers on record for Saskatchewan, but that's not stopping people from enjoying the festive season, with Santa Claus parades and holiday markets around the province.

canada.title: Paulatuk, N.W.T., looks to protect historical graveyard from shoreline erosion
canada.summary: Cape Parry used to be a home to Inuit in the 1950s and '60s who later moved to Paulatuk. Erosion is now threatening a small graveyard at the former settlement.

lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Australia, Britain, Canada and Italy on Sunday urged Israel to allow “rapid and unimpeded” humanitarian access to Gaza, calling the situation on the ground “dire,” The Canadian Press reports.

An aviation management expert says Canada is less likely than the United States to ground flights nationwide as that country did on Friday afternoon, calling the Canadian system a model its southern neighbours should look to, The Canadian Press reports.
Officials say a tanker’s steering failed before it crashed into a cruise ship in New Orleans, The Associated Press reports.

Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia’s NVDA.O chief executive, and has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
